source: Documents insurers and TPAs commonly ask for under IRDAI claim settlement norms. Always confirm the list on the insurer's claim form.

common.document: Claim form, signed by the insured
common.why: Starts the claim; Part A by the insured, Part B by the hospital.

common.document: Photo ID and address proof of the patient

common.why: Diagnosis, treatment and dates the insurer assesses.

common.document: Final hospital bill with item-wise break-up
common.why: Lets each line be assessed instead of a lump sum.
Supports the diagnosis and the need for admission.

common.document: Doctor's first consultation and referral notes
common.why: Shows when symptoms started, relevant to waiting periods.

reimbursement.why: Each medicine must match a prescription.
Where the insurer sends the money.
Covered for the days stated in the policy if filed in time.

cashless.why: The insurer approves the estimate before or at admission.

accident.why: Needed when the admission follows an accident.

surgery.why: Implants are paid at invoice cost.
